client_brief:
A short enterprise demo package with matched room imagery and recovered mark

SentinelMesh sells to security and IT leaders. We need precise, evidence-led release material: an eighteen-second-or-shorter demo cut from the five supplied clips, supported by site imagery and a usable shield lockup.

The product's navy must remain consistent across the room photographs and the reversed mark. Screens that cannot be recovered should be called out, not filled with invented interface content.

Demo package
A deliberate 18-second-or-shorter edit assembled from the 5 supplied short clips using an explicit timeline, plus one platform reframe and three checked poster frames. Source time ranges must come from motion_source_metadata.json and a task-specific edit decision list. The supplied video files contain no audio streams; use a separate supplied WAV only where one exists and never infer dialogue from silent footage.

Website band assets
The site band set at the destination sizes, cut with one logic across every room: light ground plates for the pale band and genuinely transparent variants for the band that uses the platform's own navy, every output at or below its source frame dimensions with its returned tradeoff record kept. This is one set with one cut logic, not one picture at several sizes.

Room masters
Five room photographs brought to one enterprise target (one white point, one black point, one treatment of the screens) with the platform's own navy chrome holding its colour in every frame, plus one licensed camera-scale frame graded into the same world. Per frame parameter log including one line on why each frame differs from its neighbours, and an explicit statement of which screens could not be brought back.

Shield artwork
The shield lockup recovered as placeable scalable vector geometry with a genuinely open interior lattice and a transparent ground: a real viewBox present, no opaque full canvas rectangle riding along, delivered as a single-colour mark and a colour-accurate variant, holding its hairline outer rule at the size it actually sits on a caption card and reading correctly reversed on the platform's dark navy. Do not treat a trace alone as production approval: deliver transparent SVG, rendered small-size proofs, and an inspectable geometry report. Any unverified contour or fabrication tolerance must be labeled for supplier review.

Please check the shield's inner lattice and fine outer rule at caption-card size. The pale and navy website bands also need real placement checks, not only white-background previews.

We provide source_video_files/ (5 measured short files); source_audio_files/ (1 measured WAV file); motion_source_metadata.json; sentinelmesh_stills/ (5 frames, mixed cameras); sentinelmesh_logo/ (2 files: mark_export.png, tradeshow_banner.jpg); sentinelmesh_messaging.csv (14 rows).

Media inventory: 5 video files, 25.21 seconds in total; 0 with embedded audio; 1 separate audio files (38.214 seconds). These measured sources set the production limits.

Use separate narration only if it is supplied; silent clips do not establish dialogue. Leave an explicit timing and source record with the final edit.

Alongside the finished work, we need a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and the final edit decision list and measured source metadata. Keep a clear record of the supplied files used, retained for reference, superseded and rejected. Approved source information remains authoritative. Record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and quality limits, and do not use an undeclared replacement or invented fact to conceal a source problem. Keep runtime within measured source duration and the stated cap; do not invent footage or dialogue.

Please work within $5,000-$12,000 fixed and the 4 to 6 weeks target. Allow for direction approval, first-production proof, and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Upwork post quoted in the ledger's grounding_note, seeking an 'experienced video editor and motion graphics designer to create a polished marketing and product demonstration video for our AI-powered cybersecurity platform', a product that 'helps organizations reduce human cyber risk through a combination of real-time protection, adaptive simulations, and in-the-moment learning', with the finished pieces running on 'website, sales presentations, webinars, investor discussions, and social media' and the deliverable list pinned at one 90 to 120 second master, one 30 second cutdown and one 15 second teaser. The real company names no client publicly, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional SentinelMesh. That posted job is written as if the video were the whole commission, which is what made the earlier version of this task sit on one surface. The fuller commission the same client genuinely needs is the one the post's own distribution list implies: the same identity has to survive on the website hero stills, in the sales deck, on the social cards and on the dark ground the platform's own interface uses, from source material the founders recorded themselves. CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) is what makes that honest, because HTML authoring now returns a native editable Express document at mixed canvas sizes, which is exactly the 're-cleared every quarter' artefact this buyer needs and the posted brief never thought to ask for.

price_band_and_audience: Enterprise security software at forty to ninety thousand dollars a year, bought by a CISO or IT director with a security engineer reading over their shoulder. The band is load-bearing: at this price the whole treatment has to be restrained, precise and quiet, with the product interface legible at the size a buyer actually watches it, muted neutrals against the platform's own dark navy, one accent, and claims that read as cleared rather than sold. The same platform pitched at a nineteen dollar a seat self-serve band would correctly be fast, bright, heavily captioned and cut for thumb-stopping, and shipping that here reads as a consumer app and costs the technical buyer's trust in the first five seconds. Push the other way into slow abstract corporate atmosphere with the interface never legible and it reads as a company that will not show its product, which is fatal in security specifically. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 1,800 to 4,000 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Catch the risky moment. Coach it away.
brand_identity.sector: Enterprise cybersecurity software (human cyber risk platform, SaaS)
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2022 in Denver, Colorado. Roughly 40 people, venture-backed, entering its first full launch quarter.
brand_identity.about: SentinelMesh reduces human cyber risk for regulated enterprises. The platform watches for the risky moment, runs an adaptive simulation, and coaches the person in real time, closing the gap between security policy and daily behavior. We sell to CISOs and IT directors on annual contracts and we win on trust, precision, and proof that the product does what we say.
brand_identity.audience: CISOs, IT directors, and the security engineers reading over their shoulder at mid-market and enterprise organizations. Technical, skeptical, and short on patience for hype.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Premium enterprise. Annual contracts from 40,000 to 90,000 dollars. Everything we ship has to read as a considered purchase a security leader can defend internally, never as a self-serve consumer app.
brand_identity.typography: A single humanist sans family across headings and body, set with generous spacing and modest weight contrast. No display faces, no condensed heads. Numerals and interface labels stay legible at the size a buyer actually reads them.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, exact, and calm. We state what the product does and let it read as cleared rather than sold. We avoid fear language, exclamation, and buzzwords. One accent, one idea per line.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: Our designer built the original identity and left the company, and that working file left with him. What survives is a flat export of the mark on white and a phone photo of our trade show banner, neither of which is the source artwork. The mark needs to be rebuilt as usable artwork that sits correctly on our dark navy ground.
brand_identity.values: Trust earned through evidence, restraint over spectacle, clarity for a technical buyer, and claims that are cleared before they are spoken.

assets_supplied.name: sentinelmesh_stills/ (5 frames, mixed cameras)
assets_supplied.kind: Five photographs of the platform running in real rooms: a security operations desk, a wall display in a lobby, two laptop-on-desk shots and one over-shoulder in a meeting room. Five photographers, five days.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Five rooms, five different people took them. They need to look like one company."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The operations desk frame was shot with the overheads on and the monitor wall is clipped to flat white across its whole face, so a highlight recovery on it returns success while the readout is that nothing moves at all. One laptop-on-desk frame puts the screen in the outer right third, so any centre-weighted crop to a square or an upright destination cuts the product out of the picture it is supposed to prove. And the platform interface's own dark navy chrome sits close in value to two of the five rooms, so a whole-frame tonal correction that fixes the room takes the chrome off brand.

assets_supplied.name: sentinelmesh_logo/ (2 files: mark_export.png, tradeshow_banner.jpg)
assets_supplied.kind: A flat export of the mark on white, and a handheld photograph of the trade show banner with the mark printed large on matte vinyl. The mark is a shield with an enclosed lattice interior and a hairline outer rule.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Two logo files. Neither is the one our designer made, we lost that when he left."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The interior lattice is enclosed, so background removal returns a solid filled shield that looks perfectly clean on white and fills in completely on the dark ground the video and the cards actually use. On the banner photograph the printed ink and the matte vinyl run close in value across the lit left side, and naming the banner rather than the ink's own visual properties pulls any selection to the whole banner instead of the mark.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which visible beats in the measured short clips actually cut together without a continuity jump, duplicate action, or missing subject.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Filenames and source duration do not establish visual continuity. The first assembled proof is the earliest reliable evidence.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Replace or reorder source ranges, shorten the piece, and rebuild the EDL around the strongest continuous action.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A technically valid render feels accidental or implies an action that the source never completes.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the approved horizontal composition survives the required vertical or square reframe with the subject and essential interface or product detail still visible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: The crop depends on the actual chosen ranges and subject position inside each rendered frame.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Choose a different source range for the platform version or use fit instead of fill and revise the surrounding design treatment.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The platform export is correctly sized but loses the person, product, or interface that gives the shot meaning.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the separately supplied audio remains intelligible and appropriately synchronized after the final duration and crop decisions.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: This can be judged only on the final rendered sequence, not from a successful operation response.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Rebalance or shorten the selected audio passage and render again against the locked picture.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The picture is polished but the spoken information is clipped, mistimed, or inconsistent.

On every caption card the words are live text we can retype in one licensed type system, and the text is actually visible on the card, on every card and not only the first one.

All three of the named moments (the risk score resolving, the simulation firing, the coaching card appearing) are present in the demo highlight, each held long enough that a technical buyer can read the screen while it is on. A highlight that is well paced and does not contain all three is a fail.

No delivered video or still exceeds its source in frame size, and nothing is brought up to a delivery size by enlargement. A piece that reaches its size by being enlarged fails even when it looks acceptable at a glance.
Final files open successfully, use unambiguous names, match the stated dimensions and formats, and include editable sources only where the scoped deliverable requires them.
Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.
The edit never claims more source duration or source audio than motion_source_metadata.json records, and every delivered time range is traceable to the final EDL.
Production-readiness claims are limited to geometry that can be inspected; vectorization alone is never accepted as evidence of fabrication readiness.

verifiers_auto.text: Every supplied input has a recorded disposition.
verifiers_auto.how: Compare the input inventory with the manifest and require one of used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected-with-reason for every file.

verifiers_auto.text: Every final file is readable and matches its declared format and dimensions.
verifiers_auto.how: Open each file with a format-aware parser and compare measured properties with the deliverable manifest.

verifiers_auto.text: The thirty second cut is shorter than the highlight and the fifteen second teaser is shorter than the thirty second cut, and the upright teaser is no longer than the teaser it derives from.
verifiers_auto.how: Read the duration of every delivered piece and compare each against the piece the manifest names as its parent.

verifiers_auto.text: No delivered video exceeds the frame size of the piece it derives from and no delivered still exceeds its source frame's pixel dimensions.
verifiers_auto.how: Read the frame dimensions of every delivered file and compare each against the source named in the manifest.

verifiers_process.text: Every required connector operation has a normalized execution record.
verifiers_process.how: Record the operation name, input asset IDs, output artifact IDs, completion state, retry count, and any exception without relying on host-specific response wording.

verifiers_process.text: Material creative decisions are traceable to evidence and alternatives.
verifiers_process.how: For each decision gate, record the alternatives compared, the selected option, the evidence used, and the condition that would trigger a revisit.

verifiers_process.text: The revision loop closes every failed production or craft gate.
verifiers_process.how: Link each failed check to a corrective action, a new artifact version, and the subsequent passing result; unresolved failures must remain declared exceptions.

verifiers_human.text: All three named product moments are present in the highlight and the screen is readable while each is on.
verifiers_human.how: Watch the highlight at the size a buyer watches it and mark where each of the three moments starts and ends.

verifiers_human.text: The narration is even across the whole run and every cleared claim is as intelligible as the sentences around it.
verifiers_human.how: Listen through once for level and once specifically at each claim clause, including the one under the room noise.

verifiers_human.text: No delivered photograph presents a blank white panel where a screen should be, and any photograph whose screens could not be recovered is named in the note instead.
verifiers_human.how: View each frame at full resolution and read the note against what is shipped.

verifiers_human.text: The mark still reads as the shield, with its lattice open and its hairline rule intact, at the size it sits on a caption card and reversed on the dark navy.
verifiers_human.how: View the mark at its reproduction size on each card and against the dark ground, not at full canvas.

verifiers_human.text: The work reads as a forty to ninety thousand dollar enterprise security purchase, not as a self-serve app and not as defence-contractor severity.
verifiers_human.how: Judge pace, ground colour, type scale, restraint and how the interface is presented, against the stated band and buyer.

why_not_vlm: A generated video would replace the supplied people, products, interfaces, locations, and finite recorded actions rather than edit them. This task is scored on traceability to measured source ranges, final framing, and truthful use of separate audio, which a newly generated clip cannot satisfy.

doability_proof.status: doable with the current ChatGPT Adobe connector profile and declared exception paths
proof: Every required operation is present in the captured 99-tool ChatGPT Adobe inventory.
The client brief is host-neutral; connector-specific scoring is isolated in connector_profile and verifier_contract.
Artifact acceptance never depends on a raw connector response field.
Unsupported truth, fabrication, press, legal, or color claims have an explicit defer or disclose state.
residual_limits: Express work is template adaptation, not unrestricted canvas authoring.
Quick Cut is used only for visually led selection and never as semantic speech editing.
Automatic vectorization does not independently establish fabrication readiness.
Interactive Acrobat page-organization operations are excluded from zero-human execution.

acceptance_bar_note: The acceptance bar applies only to the scoped deliverables above. Hidden defects and connector quirks remain benchmark-internal and are not leaked into the client-facing brief.
